description: This Java interface defines a Spring Data JPA repository for accessing audit log data from a SQL database, including custom query methods for filtering audit logs by various criteria such as tenant, customer, user, entity, and action types.

classes.name: AuditLogRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for AuditLogEntity with custom query methods for retrieving audit logs based on various filters.

methods.name: findByTenantId
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of AuditLogEntity objects filtered by tenant ID, optional text search, time range, and action types.

methods.name: findAuditLogsByTenantIdAndEntityId
methods.description: Retrieves audit logs for a specific tenant and entity, with optional filters for time range, action types, and text search.

methods.name: findAuditLogsByTenantIdAndCustomerId
methods.description: Retrieves audit logs for a specific tenant and customer, with optional filters for time range, action types, and text search.

methods.name: findAuditLogsByTenantIdAndUserId
methods.description: Retrieves audit logs for a specific tenant and user, with optional filters for time range, action types, and text search.
